output.answer: Twitter, now X, was most recently assigned a transaction-based equity valuation of $33 billion on March 28, 2025, when xAI acquired it; including $12 billion of debt, the stated enterprise value was $45 billion. As of November 11, 2026, there is no publicly traded market capitalization or newer separately disclosed standalone valuation, so $33 billion is the best current reference for equity value—not a live market price.
caveats: X is privately held and the $33 billion figure came from an all-stock transaction between companies controlled by Elon Musk, so it is not an independently observed public-market price.
The $45 billion number is enterprise value including debt; it should not be reported as X's equity valuation.
A newer standalone valuation may exist in private-company records or secondary transactions but was not verified from an opened source.
